mentions.name: Rumizi
mentions.description: A digital menu platform for restaurants, built with Claude Code. Each menu includes a chat assistant that diners can ask what to order. Demos are generated from publicly available data for top NYC restaurants such as Katz's Delicatessen.
mentions.problem: The author's bakery needed a cool digital menu, but no existing digital menu they found was to their liking.
mentions.source_excerpt: we need a cool digital menu as well but I couldn't find a digital menu I liked, so I asked claude code to built my own: Rumizi. Rumizi is Persian for tablecloth, the thing on the table.
mentions.author: irnco
